title: Five Stars
text: Five Stars. Beautiful and artistic ornaments.

product_metadata.title: Set of 6 Handmade Large Snowflake Iron and Glass Pendant Christmas Ornaments Tree, 9 Inches
description: Christmas ornaments large snowflakes 9 inch set of 6 wall hanging decor

Remember the magical times of childhood when you would look out the window and see perfectly preserved snowflakes frozen to the glass? You loved studying the tiny details of those gorgeous ice crystals back then, and our Set of 6 Handmade Snowflake Iron and Glass Pendant Christmas Ornaments is sure to bring to mind those special moments from days gone-by.

The Set of 6 Handmade Snowflake Iron and Glass Pendant Christmas Ornaments is a unique decoration idea for Christmas, Hanukkah, New Year's and the entire winter season. Each snowflake is painstakingly handmade from start to finish by an artist located in Old Dehli, India. While the techniques used to produce these handmade ornaments is generations old, the pendants have a modern look that will beautifully suit every home.

In the Set of 6 Handmade Snowflake Iron and Glass Pendant Christmas Ornaments, you'll find a total of six of the hanging pendants, each of which measures 9 inches by 9 inches in size. Just like snowflakes found in nature, each of these exquisite Christmas ornaments is one of a kind. The ornaments feature iron frames that are filled in with tiny pieces of glass. This gives each one a frosty look that makes it resemble actual snow. When the light shines on the ornaments, they will sparkle before your eyes, just the way that natural ice and snow creates a beautiful luster in daylight.

The Set of 6 Handmade Snowflake Iron and Glass Pendant Christmas Ornaments can be added to your holiday or winter decor in an endless number of ways. String them on a Christmas tree and enjoy the way the pendants are lit up by your twinkle lights. Hang them from a mantel covered with garland to brighten up the fireplace. You can mount them overhead to turn any space into a winter wonderland or attach them to the top of a door frame to make an entryway extra special.
Bring beauty to any room in your home
